checks.description: RDS instances must be deployed in Multi-AZ configuration for high availability
checks.impact: Single-AZ RDS instances have no automatic failover. An AZ outage or hardware failure causes complete database downtime until AWS manually restores the instance, potentially breaching SLA commitments
checks.resolution: Set multi_az = true on the aws_db_instance resource to enable synchronous standby replication across a second Availability Zone
checks.errorMessage: RDS instance is not configured for Multi-AZ deployment (multi_az must be true)
